title: Real classroom industrial technology: timber assembly and sanding techniques
learning_objective: Students practise assembly techniques for joining timber, prepare pieces for assembly, use sanding blocks and grit selection appropriately, and move between guided demonstration and independent workshop practice.
common_misconceptions: Assuming a higher grit number is rougher than a lower grit number.
Not understanding why a sanding block provides more even pressure than sanding by hand.
Trying to sand inaccessible inside faces after assembly rather than pre-sanding.
Selecting or using workshop tools without linking the tool to the material-removal problem and safety routine.
